meta.scaling: w_ji = clip(round(count_ji * 3.437500), +-200) excitatory; x0.7 for inhibitory; count = signed (Excitatory column) FlyWire synapse count; 3.437500 = g * theta / 7mV * 0.275mV * 5ms / 20ms with ONE global g = 0.5; no per-neuron gains, no damping; leak = round(lam * theta * dt_ms / 20ms), lam = 0.15
meta.source: FlyWire connectome v783 (Dorkenwald et al. 2024, Nature 634:124; Schlegel et al. 2024, Nature 634:139) as packaged for the Shiu et al. 2024 (Nature, doi:10.1038/s41586-024-07763-9) whole-brain LIF model by github.com/eonsystemspbc/fly-brain (2025_Connectivity_783.parquet)
meta.licence: FlyWire public-release data (v783) is CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial, attribution): cite Dorkenwald et al. 2024 and Schlegel et al. 2024 (FlyWire), Shiu et al. 2024 for the LIF model. This file is a derived, pruned and integer-scaled subset (demos/fly.py); NOT for commercial use.
meta.input: external lines = sensory neurons of FlyWire (sugar / bitter GRNs, LC4 looming neurons, Johnston's organ neurons, P9 walking neurons), one Bernoulli spike train per line per step with p = rate * dt
meta.criterion: candidates: non-input neurons firing >= min_rate Hz in the float full-brain model under sugar, sugar+bitter, bitter, lc4, lc4+p9, jo; per behaviour ranked by activity-weighted backward influence on its outputs; per-behaviour quotas united; synapses |count| < c_min dropped to fit nnz and lines
